installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Paper Installation Script
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=paper

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
	if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]; then
		MINECRAFT_VERSION=`curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r '[.versions[] | select(test("^1\\."))] | .[-1]'`
		echo -e "Using latest ${PROJECT} version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	else
		VER_EXISTS=`curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r --arg VERSION "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" '.versions[] | select(. == $VERSION)' | grep -m1 .`
		if [ -n "${VER_EXISTS}" ]; then
			echo -e "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
		else
			LATEST_VERSION=`curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}" | jq -r '[.versions[] | select(test("^1\\."))] | .[-1]'`
			echo -e "Specified version not found. Using the latest ${PROJECT} version: ${LATEST_VERSION}"
			MINECRAFT_VERSION=${LATEST_VERSION}
		fi
	fi

	if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ]; then
		BUILD_NUMBER=`curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | jq -r '.builds[-1]'`
		echo -e "Using latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	else
		BUILD_EXISTS=`curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | jq -e --argjson BUILD "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.builds | index($BUILD) != null' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo true || echo false`
		if [ "${BUILD_EXISTS}" = "true" ]; then
			echo -e "Build is valid for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}. Using build ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
		else
			LATEST_BUILD=`curl -fsSL "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" | jq -r '.builds[-1]'`
			echo -e "Using the latest ${PROJECT} build for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}: ${LATEST_BUILD}"
			BUILD_NUMBER=${LATEST_BUILD}
		fi
	fi

	JAR_NAME=${PROJECT}-${MINECRAFT_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar

	echo "Version being downloaded"
	echo -e "MC Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	echo -e "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	echo -e "JAR Name of Build: ${JAR_NAME}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/${PROJECT}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Running curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f ${SERVER_JARFILE} ]; then
	mv ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${SERVER_JARFILE}.old
fi

if ! curl -fsSL -o "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"; then
	echo -e "ERROR: Failed to download server jar from ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
	exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
	echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
	curl -fsSL -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi

mkdir -p YuraCloud/data

if [ "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" = "auto" ] || [ -z "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" ]; then
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated"
elif echo "${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}" | grep -qE '^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$'; then
	RESTART_TIME="${AUTO_RESTART_TIME}"
	RESTART_MODE="Admin-defined"
else
	RANDOM_HOUR=$(shuf -i 0-2 -n 1)
	RANDOM_MINUTE=$(shuf -i 0-59 -n 1)
	RESTART_TIME=$(printf "%02d:%02d" $RANDOM_HOUR $RANDOM_MINUTE)
	RESTART_MODE="Auto-generated (invalid time)"
fi

echo "Server akan restart otomatis pada jam $RESTART_TIME WIB" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart.txt
echo "inactive" > YuraCloud/data/autorestart_status.txt
echo "[INSTALL] Auto-restart schedule: $RESTART_TIME WIB ($RESTART_MODE)" >> YuraCloud/data/restart.log

echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
echo -e "      INSTALLATION COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY"
echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
echo -e " Author         : dapa@dapaproject.my.id"
echo -e " Server UUID    : ${P_SERVER_UUID}"
echo -e " MC Version     : ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
echo -e " Build Number   : ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
echo -e " Auto-Restart   : Enabled"
echo -e " Restart Time   : $RESTART_TIME WIB (Asia/Jakarta)"
echo -e " Restart Mode   : $RESTART_MODE"
echo -e " Status         : Will activate on first server start"
echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
echo -e " Powered By     : YuraCloud"
echo -e "-------------------------------------------------"
